evaluation_selection.gate_target_rule: for levels 11-14 and 23-26, perpendicular distance from the target center to the intended portal line
evaluation_selection.route_validation: reviewed collection validator: physical swept collision for wall levels; finite intended portal crossing for gate levels; sealed corner pockets excluded
evaluation_selection.selection: balanced route groups followed by deterministic farthest-point sampling over pose features
evaluation_selection.target_edge_rule: minimum axis-aligned arena-edge distance of the full rotated target-T silhouette
evaluation_selection.target_obstacle_rule: minimum distance from the full rotated target-T silhouette to the union of physical obstacle wall silhouettes
